kind: other
depth: deep
reason: deep-dynamic-structure
reason-not: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "this" {
  dynamic "origin" {
    for_each = var.origin
    content {
      domain_name = origin.value.domain_name
      dynamic "custom_origin_config" {
        for_each = origin.value.custom != null ? [origin.value.custom] : []
        content {
          origin_protocol_policy = custom_origin_config.value.protocol
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

output "arn" {
  value = aws_cloudfront_distribution.this.arn
}

variable "origin" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "this" {
  dynamic "origin" {
    for_each = var.origin
    content {
      domain_name = origin.value.domain_name
      dynamic "custom_origin_config" {
        for_each = origin.value.custom != null ? [origin.value.custom] : []
        content {
          origin_protocol_policy = custom_origin_config.value.protocol
          dynamic "origin_mtls_config" {
            for_each = custom_origin_config.value.mtls != null ? [custom_origin_config.value.mtls] : []
            content {
              client_certificate_arn = origin_mtls_config.value.arn
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

output "arn" {
  value = aws_cloudfront_distribution.this.arn
}

variable "origin" {
  type = any
}
-- base/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "cdn" {
  source = "../../"
  origin = {}
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "s3" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "AWS:SourceArn"
      values   = [module.cdn.arn]
    }
  }
}
-- head/examples/complete/main.tf --
module "cdn" {
  source = "../../"
  origin = {}
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "s3" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "AWS:SourceArn"
      values   = [module.cdn.arn]
    }
  }
}
